44	
45	`FiberBound`'s closing docstring located the obstruction in the constant: `b(κ)` is built from
46	`n₀(κ)`, a `Classical.choose` on a Noetherian stabilization re-run at each base field, and

49	`DegreeVanishing.exists_bound_subsingleton_hModule_one` is
50	
51	`b = deg D₀ + 1 − χ(𝒪)`,
52	
53	but `exists_bound_subsingleton_hModule_one` is an existential: any larger `b` works too, since
54	its conclusion is monotone in `b` (a `D` of degree `≥ b'` has degree `≥ b` when `b ≤ b'`).  So
55	one never has to transport `n₀` at all — one only has to bound `b(κ)` above, uniformly in `κ`,
56	by something computable over `k`.  And by exact Riemann–Roch the threshold can be taken to be
57	`2g − 1` where `g = genus C_κ`: past that degree `H¹` vanishes, and that expression mentions
58	`κ` only through the genus.  Hence a single `κ`-independent bound exists as soon as the genus
59	does not move.
